item.mahoudim.scroll_temporal_rewind.too: Returns you to where you were a few seconds ago: position, health and hunger.
mahoudim.book.temporal_rewind.name: Temporal Rewind
mahoudim.book.temporal_rewind.desc: Rewinds your own time: you return to your position, health and hunger from %%val1 seconds ago (even from another dimension).%%n%%nCosts %%val0 mana. Needs recent history.
item.mahoudim.scroll_time_stasis.tooltip: Freezes the entire server simulation for up to 8 seconds; everyone, including you, is stopped. Costs 100 mana per second and ends early if upkeep cannot be paid.
mahoudim.book.time_stasis.name: Time Stop
mahoudim.book.time_stasis.desc: Freezes the entire server simulation in every dimension for up to %%val2 seconds. You and every other player are frozen too. Costs %%val1 mana each second; it ends early if upkeep cannot be paid.
item.mahoudim.scroll_chrono_acceleration: Creates a stationary growth field at the point of use for 30 seconds; blocks random-tick faster. Adds 5 mana/s upkeep after the cast cost.
mahoudim.book.chrono_acceleration.name: Chrono Acceleration
mahoudim.book.chrono_acceleration.desc: Anchors a stationary growth field at the cast point, radius %%val1, for %%val2 seconds. Random-tick blocks are accelerated and you gain Speed II and Haste II. The cast costs %%val0 mana, plus 5 mana/s upkeep; the field stops when time expires or upkeep cannot be paid.
mahoudim.book.time_dilation.name: Time Dilation
mahoudim.book.time_dilation.desc: Dilates your enemies' time: within %%val1 blocks they become slow and weak for %%val2 seconds while you gain Speed.%%n%%nCosts %%val0 mana.
item.mahoudim.scroll_chrono_shift.toolti: Jump from day to night, or from night to dawn.
mahoudim.book.chrono_shift.name: Chrono Shift
mahoudim.book.chrono_shift.desc: If it is day, moves the clock to dusk-night; if it is night, skips to dawn. Does not work in fixed-time dimensions.%%n%%nCosts %%val0 mana.
item.mahoudim.scroll_spatial_step.toolti: Teleport in a straight line where you look.
mahoudim.book.spatial_step.name: Spatial Step
mahoudim.book.spatial_step.desc: Fold space and appear up to %%val1 blocks ahead, at the last free spot before an obstacle.%%n%%nCosts %%val0 mana.
item.mahoudim.scroll_spatial_anchor.tool: Mark a point (sneaking) and return to it from any dimension.
mahoudim.book.spatial_anchor.name: Spatial Anchor
mahoudim.book.spatial_anchor.desc: While sneaking, marks your position as the anchor (the scroll is kept, mana is spent). Without sneaking, you travel to the anchor from any dimension and the scroll is consumed.%%n%%nCosts %%val0 mana.
item.mahoudim.scroll_spatial_vacuum.tool: Pulls nearby items and experience to you.
mahoudim.book.spatial_vacuum.name: Spatial Vacuum
mahoudim.book.spatial_vacuum.desc: Folds space and brings every item and experience orb within %%val1 blocks to your feet.%%n%%nCosts %%val0 mana.
item.mahoudim.scroll_spatial_tunnel.tool: Digs a 3x3 tunnel and sends the loot to your inventory.
mahoudim.book.spatial_tunnel.name: Spatial Cut
mahoudim.book.spatial_tunnel.desc: Cuts space and opens a 3x3 tunnel %%val1 blocks long where you look. Drops go straight to your inventory. Respects protections; skips chests and bedrock.%%n%%nCosts %%val0 mana. Great for the Mining Realm.
mahoudim.gui.title: Dimensional Gate
mahoudim.gui.hint.mining: Caves rich in the chosen ore. Deeper = rarer.
mahoudim.gui.hint.chrono: Floating isles under an eternal dusk.
mahoudim.gui.hint.fae: A quiet glade of the fae folk.
mahoudim.msg.no_switch: You cannot switch realms from here.
mahoudim.msg.no_dimension: Dimension %s does not exist (check the datapack).
mahoudim.msg.not_in_realm: You are not in a realm.
mahoudim.msg.no_anchor: You have no anchor (mark it while sneaking).
mahoudim.book.intro.name: Dimensional Arcana
mahoudim.book.intro.desc: New arts for the magus: alternate realms opened from a Dimensional Gate, plus time and space techniques.%%n%%nEverything uses the same mana and powdered catalysts as the rest of the magic.
mahoudim.book.realms.name: The Realms
mahoudim.book.realms.desc: There are four realms: the Mining Realm (Veins, one variant per ore), the Chrono Isles, the Spatial Rift and the Fae Glade.%%n%%nEvery visit builds an anchor chamber with a return Gate.
mahoudim.book.gate_use.name: Using the Gate
mahoudim.book.gate_use.desc: Right-click the Dimensional Gate to open its interface.%%n%%nPick realm, focus ore, depth, danger, richness and time flow. Changing the Zone generates a fresh vein in another region.%%n%%nThe cost is shown before opening the portal.
mahoudim.book.mining.name: Mining Realm
mahoudim.book.mining.desc: A cave world with far more ore than normal. You arrive in a sealed chamber: time to mine.%%n%%nSurface, mid or deep change the arrival point. The Veins have no villages or structures.
mahoudim.book.ores.name: Focus ores
mahoudim.book.ores.desc: The focus ore multiplies its amount in the realm. Each ore changes cost and risk:%%n%%nCoal, Copper, Iron: cheap and safe.%%nGold, Redstone, Lapis: danger +1.%%nDiamond, Emerald: expensive, danger +2.%%n%%n'All' spreads ores evenly.
mahoudim.book.chrono_isles.name: Chrono Isles
mahoudim.book.chrono_isles.desc: Floating islands under a sunset that never ends. Time is stopped here: perfect for building and studying the arts of time.
mahoudim.book.spatial_rift.name: Spatial Rift
mahoudim.book.spatial_rift.desc: A fractured void where space is broken: shards of End stone and purpur floating at different heights. Beware the Endermen.
mahoudim.book.fae_glade.name: Fae Glade
mahoudim.book.fae_glade.desc: A serene glade in the colors of the fae folk. Ideal to rest, farm and gather materials without much pressure.
mahoudim.book.modifiers.name: Modifiers
mahoudim.book.modifiers.desc: Danger: empowers monsters and, from 2, periodic reinforcements appear.%%nRichness: chance to double ore drops.%%nTime flow: Speed and Haste while inside.%%nDepth and focus ore make the trip costlier.
mahoudim.book.return.name: Returning
mahoudim.book.return.desc: The anchor chamber has a Dimensional Gate: use it and press Return. You can also switch realms from there.%%n%%nIf you lose the chamber, use the command /mahoudim return.
mahoudim.book.time_arts.name: Arts of Time
mahoudim.book.time_arts.desc: Temporal arts bend the flow of time. Their rituals use Emerald and Quartz. Carpets are required only by specific rituals; check each recipe in the book or JEI. Click ordinary result circles to claim their scroll.
mahoudim.book.space_arts.name: Arts of Space
mahoudim.book.space_arts.desc: Techniques that fold space. They are drawn with Ender powder. Each circle needs spell cloth to yield its scroll.
mahoudim.book.dimensional_gate.name: Dimensional Gate
mahoudim.book.dimensional_gate.desc: Persistent circle. Right-click opens the interface to configure and open realms. Trips cost mana (from %%val0 for the basic mining realm).
mahoudim.book.spatial_pocket.name: Spatial Pocket
mahoudim.book.spatial_pocket.desc: Persistent circle that opens your Ender chest: storage in another space, available wherever you draw it.%%n%%nEach use costs %%val0 mana.
mahoudim.book.ores.compat: The Modded ores profile generates extra veins from the c:ores or forge:ores tags. Mods that tag their ores are detected automatically.
mahoudim.gui.hint.empty: Espacio vacío para construir y personalizar
mahoudim.book.realms.monster_farm: Dimensión exclusiva para farmear monstruos: aparecen criaturas hostiles y no genera minerales.
mahoudim.book.realms.empty: Dimensión vacía para construir. La Puerta conserva zona, peligro, riqueza, flujo y perfil de minerales para personalizarla.
item.mahoudim.scroll_temporal_bubble.too: Slows enemies in a time bubble and speeds you up.
mahoudim.book.temporal_bubble.name: Temporal Bubble
mahoudim.book.temporal_bubble.desc: Creates a time bubble: enemies slow down while you move and mine faster. No spell cloth required.
item.mahoudim.scroll_time_leap.tooltip: Advances the local time of the dimension.
mahoudim.book.time_leap.name: Time Leap
mahoudim.book.time_leap.desc: Jumps the local clock forward and gives you a short burst of speed. No spell cloth required.
item.mahoudim.scroll_spatial_swap.toolti: Swap places with the nearest hostile mob.
mahoudim.book.spatial_swap.name: Spatial Swap
mahoudim.book.spatial_swap.desc: Trades your position with the nearest hostile creature in range. No spell cloth required.
item.mahoudim.scroll_spatial_beacon.tool: Returns you to your last dimensional gate.
mahoudim.book.spatial_beacon.name: Spatial Beacon
mahoudim.book.spatial_beacon.desc: Uses the dimensional network to return you to your last gate. No spell cloth required.
mahoudim.msg.no_swap_target: There is no nearby enemy to swap with.
mahoudim.book.realms.archive: Un archivo de islas cronales para estudiar el tiempo, con reloj detenido y esqueletos guardianes.
mahoudim.book.realms.labyrinth: Una red de fragmentos de la Fisura Espacial: el espacio se retuerce y los endermen acechan.
item.mahoudim.scroll_chrono_garden.toolt: Creates a fixed growth field at the point of use for 20 seconds. Costs 5 mana/s; the Second Sorcery Code increases duration and halves upkeep.
mahoudim.book.chrono_garden.name: Chrono Garden
mahoudim.book.chrono_garden.desc: Creates a stationary growth field at the cast point (scroll) or at the ritual circle. Right-click the circle to toggle it. Radius %%val1, duration %%val2 seconds. The cast costs %%val0 mana, plus 5 mana/s while active. It stops when duration expires or upkeep cannot be paid.
item.mahoudim.scroll_temporal_regenerati: Grants Regeneration, Saturation and Absorption to restore health, hunger and a temporary shield.
mahoudim.book.temporal_regeneration.name: Temporal Regeneration
mahoudim.book.temporal_regeneration.desc: Restores your body with Regeneration III, Saturation and Absorption for a short time. No spell cloth required.%%n%%nCosts %%val0 mana.
item.mahoudim.scroll_time_shelter.toolti: Freezes nearby mobs in place and grants you Resistance II for a short time.
mahoudim.book.time_shelter.name: Temporal Shelter
mahoudim.book.time_shelter.desc: Freezes mobs within %%val1 blocks and protects you with Resistance II for %%val2 seconds. No spell cloth required.%%n%%nCosts %%val0 mana.
item.mahoudim.scroll_spatial_pulse.toolt: Expulsa a los enemigos cercanos doblando el espacio.
mahoudim.book.spatial_pulse.name: Pulso Espacial
mahoudim.book.spatial_pulse.desc: Expulsa a los enemigos cercanos doblando el espacio. No requiere tela de hechizo.
item.mahoudim.scroll_spatial_phase.toolt: Te vuelve invisible, resistente y ligero durante unos segundos.
mahoudim.book.spatial_phase.name: Fase Espacial
mahoudim.book.spatial_phase.desc: Te vuelve invisible, resistente y ligero durante unos segundos. No requiere tela de hechizo.
item.mahoudim.scroll_void_step.tooltip: Un salto espacial de largo alcance para cruzar grandes distancias.
mahoudim.book.void_step.name: Paso del Vacío
mahoudim.book.void_step.desc: Un salto espacial de largo alcance para cruzar grandes distancias. No requiere tela de hechizo.
item.mahoudim.scroll_temporal_core.toolt: Opens the field settings. From its ritual circle, the field stays anchored to that circle; from a scroll, it is anchored where you opened the menu.
mahoudim.book.temporal_core.name: Temporal Core
mahoudim.book.temporal_core.desc: Choose radius, duration and tick multiplier in the menu. A ritual circle anchors the field at its own position; a scroll anchors it where cast. It speeds random-tickable blocks, charges the scroll cast cost plus 5 mana/s, and stops at the selected duration or when unpaid. Sneak-right-click the circle to toggle it.
item.mahoudim.scroll_dimension_tuner.too: Abre la interfaz de dimensiones sin hacer clic en una Puerta.
mahoudim.book.dimension_tuner.name: Sintonía Dimensional
mahoudim.book.dimension_tuner.desc: Abre remotamente la interfaz de la Puerta Dimensional. Debes haber usado o configurado una Puerta antes. No requiere tela de hechizo.
mahoudim.core.title: Temporal Core
mahoudim.core.hint: Field is anchored at the circle or the point where the menu was opened; upkeep is 5 mana/s.
item.mahoudim.mahora_wheel.tooltip: Wear it as a helmet. It learns each damage type separately, reducing it by up to 80% after nine hits. Accepts helmet enchantments.
item.mahoudim.scroll_mahora_adaptation.t: Summons a Mahora Wheel. Equip it on your head to adapt to repeated damage.
mahoudim.book.mahora_arts.name: Mahora Rituals
mahoudim.book.mahora_arts.desc: Rituals that call forth the wheel of adaptation.
mahoudim.book.mahora_adaptation.name: Mahora Adaptation
mahoudim.book.mahora_adaptation.desc: The ritual grants a Mahora Wheel. Wear it in the head slot to learn each damage type separately. The first reduction begins after three hits; every two more hits add 20% reduction, up to 80% after nine hits. Progress for each damage type resets after five minutes without another hit. After the wheel records at least one adaptation, wearing it also grants Strength I.
mahoudim.msg.mahora_already_have_wheel: You already carry a Mahora Wheel.
mahoudim.msg.mahora_wheel_received: The Mahora Wheel recognizes you. Equip it on your head to adapt.
mahoudim.msg.mahora_adapted: The wheel turns: adaptation level %s/4 for that damage type.
item.mahoudim.juadana.tooltip: Deals 20 damage. Each kill charges it; at 100, the next strike deals 100 damage and resets the bar. Accepts sword enchantments.
item.mahoudim.juadana_ritual_scroll: Ritual Scroll of the Soul Reaper
item.mahoudim.juadana_ritual_scroll.tool: Right-click once to receive the Soul Reaper Scythe. The scroll is consumed.
message.mahoudim.juadana_ritual_claimed: You received the Soul Reaper Scythe.
item.mahoudim.second_sorcery_code.toolti: Upgrades the First Sorcery Code: six technique slots, twice the durability, 50% less mana cost, and 50% stronger addon techniques. You can select techniques with it in your offhand when your main hand has no other Mystic Code, using the configured wheel key. Its rotating arcane circles glow violet, cyan, and amber.
hud.mahoudim.juadana.ready: Charged: the next strike deals 100 damage!
mahoudim.book.juadana.name: Soul Reaper Scythe
mahoudim.book.juadana.desc: Deals 20 damage. Each kill with the scythe adds 1 charge point (100 total). Once full, the next hit deals 100 damage and resets the charge.%%n%%nIt is not made in a crafting table: obtain it through the Ritual Scroll of the Soul Reaper on the next page.
mahoudim.book.juadana_ritual.name: Ritual Scroll of the Soul Reaper
mahoudim.book.juadana_ritual.desc: Combine the three powders in this Mahoujin recipe and place four wool carpets directly beside the north, south, east, and west sides of the circle. When the result circle appears, right-click it with an empty hand to collect the scroll. Then right-click the scroll once to receive the Scythe; do not hold the button.
mahoudim.book.second_sorcery_code.name: Second Sorcery Code
mahoudim.book.second_sorcery_code.desc: Upgrades the First Sorcery Code. JEI recipe: place the original Code in the center, Mahora Powder in the four corners, and Powdered Diamond on the four sides.%%n%%nCarries over the original Code's three scrolls and stores up to 6 scrolls selectable with the Code wheel, even when held in the offhand as long as the main hand has no other Mystic Code. Has twice the durability of the First Sorcery Code. When addon techniques are cast from it, mana cost is reduced by 50% and applicable range, radius, duration, and effect levels are increased by 50%.
mahoudim.book.carpet_ritual_rules.name: Carpet Ritual Layout
mahoudim.book.carpet_ritual_rules.desc: To complete enchantment rituals and the Scythe ritual, place four wool carpets around the circle: north, south, east, and west, one directly beside each side. The carpets stay in place and are not consumed. You do not need Spell Cloth or carpets in your inventory.
mahoudim.book.enchantments.name: Ritual Enchantments
mahoudim.book.enchantments.desc: Twenty new enchantments, each with its own ritual recipe. Every ritual requires four wool carpets placed north, south, east, and west. The result circle gives a standard scroll; right-click once to receive its level-I enchanted book. The carpets are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.cadencia_suspe: After three consecutive hits on the same target, the next hit briefly reduces its attack speed. Resets on a target change or after 2 seconds. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.ancla_de_inerc: Your hits reduce knockback from that same target for 1 second, without increasing damage or changing its knockback. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.marca_de_retor: Arrows briefly mark their target. If it leaves your view, subtle particles help you locate it without revealing it through blocks. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.umbral_de_impa: A trident hit shortly after a target enters or leaves water applies Slowness. Each target has an 8-second cooldown. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
After blocking a hit with an offhand shield, your next sword hit marks the blocked attacker with particles for 2 seconds. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.pulso_de_estra: Mining ore briefly marks nearby exposed, visible ores with particles. It reveals no hidden blocks and grants no extra drops. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.reticula_de_co: Harvesting a mature crop also harvests mature crops nearby in a 3×3 area. It does not replant or affect immature crops. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.reloj_de_desga: After mining a set number of blocks, your next mined block avoids 1 durability damage. Activates at most once every 12 seconds. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.sondeo_de_veta: Mining stone or deepslate in natural terrain sometimes points toward a nearby cavity. It does not identify ores; cave detection is approximate. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.corte_de_inter: After shearing, a sheep regrows its wool sooner than usual; this can allow more shearing over time. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.pliegue_de_gua: After taking damage, reduce your next knockback within 2 seconds; then it recharges for 10 seconds. Does not reduce damage taken. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.paso_de_fase.d: After landing from a short fall, avoid the drag from the first powder-snow block you touch. Does not reduce fall damage. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
After standing still and crouching for 3 seconds, reduce hostile mobs’ target acquisition range. Ends when you move or attack. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.memoria_de_umb: When crossing a portal, briefly preserves your cardinal heading and smooths the initial camera turn. Does not change coordinates. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.costura_de_ins: After consecutive hits, show your character a brief visual trail toward the damage source. Does not affect combat or defense. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.brujula_de_ret: Use the compass to switch between the Overworld spawn and the last saved dimensional exit. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.cuerda_de_mare: After a catch, your next valid cast from the shore toward water gains speed. Does not change bites or loot. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.resonancia_de_: Ring a bell while holding an enchanted item to reveal nearby villagers with particles, without changing their behavior. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.nudo_de_anclaj: Blocking a projectile with a shield briefly reduces knockback received. Does not reflect projectiles or increase blocking. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.book.enchantment.reserva_de_com: Use a clock during rain for a signal when the rainy phase is close to ending. Does not change the weather. Place four wool carpets north, south, east, and west around the circle; they are not consumed.
mahoudim.msg.compass_portal: Compass set to the last saved dimensional exit.
mahoudim.msg.compass_spawn: Compass set to the Overworld spawn.
mahoudim.msg.rain_soon: The clock senses that the rain is about to clear.
item.mahoudim.ritual_reward_scroll.toolt: Right-click once to receive the ritual item or book. The scroll is consumed.
message.mahoudim.enchantment_scroll_clai: You received the enchanted book for %s.
message.mahoudim.ritual_scroll_unavailab: The ritual reward is unavailable; the scroll was not consumed.
message.mahoudim.carpet_ritual_requires_: This ritual requires four wool carpets: north, south, east, and west of the circle.
mahoudim.book.unlimited_projection.name: Unlimited Projection
mahoudim.book.unlimited_projection.desc: Memorize any damageable item you target, including items from other mods. Items with internal inventories are not copied. Using the technique again creates a projected copy with its components. It keeps Projection’s durability cost and respects the server blacklist. Costs %%val0 mana.
item.mahoudim.scroll_unlimited_projectio: Target any damageable item to memorize it. Use again to create a projected copy, including items from other mods. Items with internal inventories are excluded.
message.mahoudim.unlimited_projection_no: You are not targeting a projectable damageable item.
message.mahoudim.unlimited_projection_me: Memorized %s. Use the scroll again to project it.
The memorized item can no longer be projected; its memory was cleared.
mahoudim.msg.time_stop_busy: Time is already stopped by another spell.
mahoudim.msg.time_stop_server_frozen: The server is already frozen externally; Time Stop cannot take control.
mahoudim.msg.time_stop_started: Time stopped globally for %s s. Upkeep: %s mana/s.
mahoudim.msg.time_stop_interrupted: Time resumed because the server freeze was changed externally.
mahoudim.msg.time_stop_no_mana: Time resumed: you could not pay the mana upkeep.
mahoudim.msg.time_stop_need_mana: Time Stop needs %s mana for its first second.
mahoudim.msg.field_no_mana: The growth field stopped; it needs %s mana for upkeep.
mahoudim.msg.chrono_garden_started: Growth field anchored at the cast point for %s s; upkeep: %s mana/s.
mahoudim.msg.core_anchor_invalid: The Temporal Core circle is no longer available at that position.
mahoudim.msg.core_field_started: Core field active for %s s; radius %s, tick multiplier %sx.
mahoudim.msg.perimeter_owner: Only the caster can control this perimeter.
mahoudim.book.effect_increment.name: Effect Increment
mahoudim.book.effect_increment.desc: Choose an effect you already have and increase its level. Remaining duration is preserved; higher levels cost more mana. Supports effects registered by other mods.%%n%%nCosts %%val0 mana.
item.mahoudim.scroll_effect_increment.to: Increase the level of one of your active effects at a mana cost.
mahoudim.book.effect_create.name: Effect Create
mahoudim.book.effect_create.desc: With no book or water potion in your offhand, apply the effect directly to yourself. Hold a book to create an inscription tome, or a water potion to create a custom potion that is added to your inventory. Choose any registered effect, its level, duration, and particles. Combine the tome with a tool in an anvil to inscribe it; holding the item keeps the effect active.%%n%%nCosts %%val0 mana.
item.mahoudim.scroll_effect_create.toolt: With no offhand item, apply the effect to yourself. Hold a book to create a tome, or a water potion to create a custom potion. Choose the effect, level, duration, and particles.
item.mahoudim.effect_inscription_book.ap: Combine with a tool or armor in an anvil to inscribe the effect.
item.mahoudim.effect_inscription_book.wh: The effect stays active while you hold the inscribed item.
item.mahoudim.effect_inscribed.tooltip: Magically inscribed: effect active while held.
item.mahoudim.scroll_unlimited_projectio: Sneak and right-click to clear memory.
mahoudim.msg.effect_increment_none: You need at least one active effect.
mahoudim.msg.effect_increment_invalid: The target level must be higher than the current effect level.
mahoudim.msg.effect_create_catalyst: Hold a book or water potion in your offhand.
mahoudim.msg.effect_menu_expired: The effect selection expired; use the technique again.
mahoudim.msg.effect_invalid_duration: Duration must be between 1 and 72000 seconds.
